confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied context; no live listings or booking pages were checked. The Egyptian pound has been volatile since its 2024 float and local inflation has been high, so USD-equivalent levels for July 2026 could plausibly differ by 20 percent or more from these figures. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; hotel and hostel rates and the drink anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (wine at a moderate premium to beer, cocktail at a larger premium) because direct Cairo knowledge of those prices is thin. Beer is priced as a domestic lager serving, since draught is less common in ordinary Cairo venues than bottles. The FX figure comes from RBA data surfaced in search results; the RBA table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is a North African and Levant regional comparison: Cairo's restaurant and budget-lodging levels were benchmarked against capitals with similar tourism infrastructure such as Tunis and Casablanca, with Amman as a higher-cost reference. Hotel tiers reflect registered central-Cairo hotels at ordinary summer rates rather than resort or Gulf-style pricing.
